title: feat(lint)!: refuse a bulk action's confirmText hole over an unbound root, a single-brace token, a hole holding logic and a blank sentence at validate, compile and the publish gate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao2bTBgLstWH97J6JDCaAAFh)_

Fixes #25205

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

The refusal half of ruling `6285948976` item 1 on #24798, verbatim: "an unbound root and a single-brace token are refused by name at `objectstack validate`, `compile` and the publish gate through the one judge the flow text slots use (`automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts`)". #24947 (merged as `925fd0772c`) typed the slot and shipped every finding as a warning. Under the amended 「甲」 (#6015 `6303865025`) this narrowing ships now, in 18.x, as its own BREAKING minor, shaped like #25002's page-predicate bounds.

## What changes

- **The bulk `confirmText` pass refuses** (`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`, `bulkConfirmTextIssues`). Every finding is now `severity: 'error'`, pushed the way the flow text slots push theirs, and the `BULK_CONFIRM_TEXT_WARNING_ONLY` suffix is gone. The judge, the walk and the sentences are unchanged. The four refused texts are a hole over a root the def does not bind, a single-brace `{x}` token, a hole holding logic or an unknown formatter, and a blank sentence.
- **How it reaches each door.** `objectstack validate` and `compile` fail on an `error` from `validateStackExpressions`. The publish gate splits `errors` from `advisories` by severity (`runtime-gate.ts`), so an active `view` or `object` write, and a draft promotion, now answer `422 INVALID_METADATA` with an `expression-invalid` issue at `bulkActionDefs[N] confirmText`. No door code moves.
- **The blank `''` arm is kept** (`packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts`, comment and describe only). The doors refuse a blank sentence in this same change, as they refuse the other three. The parse is what the boot load (`computeMetadataDiagnostics` in `loadMetaFromDb`) and the read path judge a stored view with. Dropping the arm would make a stored blank sentence an invalid row on load, a narrowing wider than the three doors the ruling names, and one #25002's precedent avoids ("Stored pages are not migrated and are not refused on read"). With the arm kept, every bulk `confirmText` finding is one kind of verdict: a door refusal over text that parses. A stored view keeps loading until its next save, and that save is judged. The new door test (d) pins this for a blank and for an unbound hole.
- **Prose made false by the flip, corrected:** the slot's `.describe()` (it said "as a warning"), the regenerated references (`content/docs/references/ui/{bulk-action,component,view}.mdx`), the `authoring-rules.ts` registration comment, a `runtime-gate.test.ts` comment, and the dogfood `expression-conformance.ledger.ts` row's `enforcement` text.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/25205-bulk-confirm-text-refusal.md`: `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, both declaration lines, a FROM/TO block, and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, worded like #25002's.

## Producers, measured first (through the built `@objectstack/lint`)

- Shipped corpus at `925fd0772c`: the only non-test bulk defs with a `confirmText` are the 6 in `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/project.view.ts`, all holeless: 0 findings, against 1 for a planted `{{ nope }}` control. No `platform-objects`, `skills/` or other example module declares one.
- HotCRM `origin/main` `1e71d5e` (read-only): `src/sales/views/account.view.ts` declares the 3 bulk sentences (`{{count}}`, and `{{tier}}` on the def whose param is `tier`): 0 findings, against an `error` for a planted `{count}` control. The other 9 of the card's 12 are their es-ES / ja-JP / zh-CN translations in locale bundles, which this pass does not read; they use the same two roots. No producer is refused.

## Tests (head `6a4c0663`)

- `validate-expressions.bulk-confirm-text.test.ts`: the pins flip from `warning` to `error`, the "no error at all" case inverts to "no warning at all", and the gate block now asserts `errors` with empty `advisories` on all three view shapes, plus a single-brace and a blank case per shape.
- New door block in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`, through the real `saveMetaItem`: (a) each of the four texts is refused with `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 and nothing is stored, and the draft promotion is refused too; (b) the door's finding equals `runAuthoringRules('build', …)`'s on `rule`, `where` and `message`; (c) control: the HotCRM sentence saves; (d) a stored view with a blank or an unbound sentence loads (`invalid: 0`) and its next save is refused, the row untouched.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `severity: 'error'` back to `'warning'` in the push helper; blob `b86ef1862f5b` → `7ab1d8f7b6ad`; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in 4 built files of `packages/lint/dist`): lint `Tests 11 failed | 6 passed`, door `Tests 8 failed | 1 passed` (the passing one is control (c)). Restore leg: blob back to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, lint rebuilt, preflight `--absent` clean, door 9/9 green. A first attempt's preflight spelled the dist marker with single quotes and read ABSENT although the build carried it; that run is not counted, and the run above is the re-take with the emitted spelling.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 156/156 files, 7196 tests; typecheck exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 261 passed / 3 skipped files, 21456 passed / 19 skipped; typecheck exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 712/712 files, 21657 passed, 1 todo; typecheck exit 0. `check:generated` green after `--fix` regenerated the three references.
- Full dogfood (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, owed by the `(narrowing)` arm) at `e644a80a`: 290 passed / 3 skipped files, 2494 passed / 18 skipped. `6a4c0663` changes one string in the ledger row (it dropped a tracker id that `check:doc-authoring` named); `expression-conformance.test.ts` re-ran there: 8/8.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` gives 112 families, the same list at both heads. Results are in the os-dev-report comment.

## Acceptance notes

- Translated bulk `confirmText` strings in translation bundles are still not judged for holes, as before this change: the ruling binds the def's slot. #24947's report carries this to #24814.
- Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is the seat's. No governed surface is touched (`.claude/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `skills/**`, `.github/workflows/**`).
- #24814, the parallel text-slot sweep, also edits `validate-expressions.ts`; this diff stays inside the bulk block and its two comments.
